label: Backfill catalog track source IDs
summary: Copy source ownership from durable tracks into catalog projections

execute.description: Copy source ownership from durable tracks into catalog projections
execute.sql:
UPDATE "CatalogTrack"
             SET "sourceId" = (
               SELECT "Track"."sourceId"
               FROM "Track"
               WHERE "Track"."id" = "CatalogTrack"."id"
             )
             WHERE EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
               FROM "Track"
               WHERE "Track"."id" = "CatalogTrack"."id"
                 AND "Track"."sourceId" IS NOT NULL
             )

label: Backfill available album track counts
summary: Initialize available counts from the current catalog projections

execute.description: Initialize available counts from the current catalog projections
execute.sql:
UPDATE "CatalogAlbum"
             SET "availableTrackCount" = (
               SELECT COUNT(*)
               FROM "CatalogTrack"
               WHERE "CatalogTrack"."albumId" = "CatalogAlbum"."id"
                 AND "CatalogTrack"."available" = 1
             )

label: Backfill available artist track counts
summary: Initialize available counts from current catalog artist links

execute.description: Initialize available counts from current catalog artist links
execute.sql:
UPDATE "CatalogArtist"
             SET "availableTrackCount" = (
               SELECT COUNT(*)
               FROM "CatalogTrackArtist"
               INNER JOIN "CatalogTrack"
                 ON "CatalogTrack"."id" = "CatalogTrackArtist"."trackId"
               WHERE "CatalogTrackArtist"."artistId" = "CatalogArtist"."id"
                 AND "CatalogTrack"."available" = 1
             )
